description: Discord's raid-defense security actions for the whole server. Pause new invites, and pause DMs between members who are not friends, each for up to 24 hours, to lock the server down during a raid. Give a number of hours to pause, 0 to lift a pause, or omit a field to leave it unchanged. Called with neither field, it reports the current state, including any raid or DM spam Discord detected on its own.

dms.description: Hours to pause DMs between non-friend members, up to 24. Use 0 to resume, or omit to leave them unchanged.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

invites.description: Hours to pause new invites, up to 24. Use 0 to resume invites, or omit to leave them unchanged.

name: set_incident_actions
title: Pause invites and DMs
